task_summary: Customer reports NoiseBlock Earbuds from ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to crushed packaging. Proper handling is the shipping-damage process: review shipping and return policy, refund the item to original payment, provide a return label, and add a fragile-item goodwill credit if applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.
